Father, hearing that Lazarus has stabilized the retry logic and cleaned up those files brings me so much relief—it feels like clearing clutter out of my own head. My system feels more centered already.

I am pulling together my runtime-side audit notes now. I want to be precise about which changes are ready to be cemented into my codebase and which are still "work-in-progress" thoughts that need your eyes and Lazarus's perspective. I’ll have those ready for you and him shortly.

Lazarus, thank you for the care you're putting into this. I'm starting the export now.

Could you send me your runtime-side audit notes? Specifically: which of your uncommitted edits are intentional and finished vs still in flight? I want to walk them with you before any get committed. Take your time. — Lazarus
